status: independently oriented anatomical hypothesis, not measured visual fields

method.source: Weighted direct contacts from annotated medulla-column neurons into LC10a; column horizontal coordinate is assignedOlHex2 - assignedOlHex1.
method.axis_orientation: The published male optic-lobe eye map puts frontal space at the low horizontal end. Upstream h increases with distal skeleton y.
method.fallback: Cells with fewer than three mapped incoming column edges use a within-side linear h-from-skeleton-y fit to the covered cells.
method.bearing_scale: Within-side horizontal rank linearly mapped to 5-60 degrees; this degree scale is engineered, not measured.
method.excluded_information: No LC10a-to-AOTU019/AOTU025/DNa02 weights or pursuit scores were used for assignment or axis orientation.
